note:
THE WHOLE DESCENT, one clip: stand, in the doorway, leading foot down, stand.

It was two chores back to back and they played stand -> doorway -> stand -> foot down -> stand, because every chore begins and ends on the stand frame so it cannot pop. Chained, that rule made him STRAIGHTEN UP MID-DESCENT, between the two halves of one continuous movement -- which read as a glitch and was reported as one.

A chore is a held pose between two hard cuts, not an animation. That is fine for a shrug and wrong for a descent, and the answer is not a mechanism but a clip that covers the whole motion.

`contact` is the doorway, `commit` is the foot landing. Frames 0 and 5 are still the stand frame byte for byte.
